title: atlas.corridor.hints.v1
description: Per-member green-wave offset hints from one Corridor Coordinator, recomputed every 60s (docs/design/04_agent_architecture.md section 4.2; docs/design/05_communication.md section 5.2's topic table). Advisory only -- consumed as a policy observation feature (MultiAgentSignalEnv.set_corridor_hints), never a command; intersections remain the single writer of their own signals.

offset_s.description: Recommended green-start offset relative to the corridor's first junction, from greenwave.compute_greenwave_offsets.

hint_value.description: The normalized value actually fed into the agent's observation vector (MultiAgentSignalEnv.set_corridor_hints) -- a derived, bounded transform of offset_s, not the raw seconds figure.
